input.query: WITH monthly AS (SELECT a.month, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.is_active THEN a.user_id END) active_users, SUM(a.card_spend_eur) spend, SUM(a.card_spend_eur)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.is_active THEN a.user_id END),0) spend_per_active, SUM(a.n_card_txns)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.is_active THEN a.user_id END),0) txns_per_active FROM fct_activity_monthly a JOIN dim_users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.country='RO' AND a.month >= DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY a.month) SELECT * FROM monthly WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01' ORDER BY month
